'''2003 World Championship Day 2/3 Mike Gemme DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Gemme]] at [[2003 World Championship]] (Day 2/3), finishing 8th; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by michael "Deck" Gemme (2003-10-17).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=30568 KTOD Huntdown]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050525170527/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=30568&PHPSESSID=...328fedb22570524062aeb1303 Internet Archive]</ref>
